decision.rationale: I'm declining this dispute because it was opened after the time limit. TXN-008064 (711.89 EUR, RIVERSIDE GADGETS, card CRD-000189) posted on 2026-05-12, and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-26. That is 167 days after posting, and the policy allows 120 days. Section time-limits says a late dispute is declined even when the transaction carries fraud indicators. That applies here: authorisation AUTH-008258 was an online payment with no 3-D Secure check, no CVV and the fraud flag set. Those signals would otherwise support treating it as unauthorised, but the time limit is applied first and decides the case.

proposed_actions.reason: The dispute was opened 167 days after the transaction posted on 2026-05-12. Disputes must be opened within 120 days of posting, and this limit applies even when a transaction shows signs of fraud.
